[Profile] Profile Image Preview

Overview

Item Details
Feature Profile Image Preview
Actor Signed-in user
Module Profile
QA owner @ekosy9
Project owner @lundara02
Target devices Android 13 (8 GB), Android 10 (4 GB)

Feature intent

A user can tap their visible profile image to open a larger preview, then dismiss that preview without leaving the Profile screen.

Main validation flow

Step User action Expected result
1 Sign in with an account that has a profile image. Profile data and avatar load.
2 Open Profile. Avatar is visible in the profile header.
3 Tap the avatar. Profile image preview opens over the current screen.
4 Tap outside the preview. Preview closes; Profile remains usable.

Coverage plan

Area Scenario Method
Main flow Open and dismiss profile image preview. Black-box
Integration Avatar tap triggers preview state and overlay. Gray-box
Implementation Review tap handler, preview state, and dismiss action. White-box
Regression Profile loads normally after preview is dismissed. Regression

QA Summary — 28 August 2026

Item Result
Status No Test / Skipped
Reason Intended preview UI is not available for acceptance validation.
Runtime check Real Android device and authenticated profile checked; not recorded as feature verdict.
Follow-up Re-test after intended UI and acceptance flow are delivered.

QA Decision

No pass, fail, bug, regression, or smoke-test verdict recorded. This issue remains No Test.

Overview

Module Profile
QA owner @ekosy9
Project owner @lundara02
Target devices Android 13 (8 GB), Android 10 (4 GB)

Feature intent and validation flow

The Profile header must show a Total Post value consistent with that profile's Posts grid.

Step Action Expected result
1 Sign in with an account that has posts. Profile data loads.
2 Open Profile. Total Post counter is visible.
3 Inspect the Posts grid. Counter matches the posts shown.
4 Scroll the grid. Posts remain available and the count stays accurate.

Gray-box Failed: counter and grid followed separate runtime data paths.
White-box summary.userCount.posts drove the counter; fetchProfilePosts drove the grid.
Regression Grid worked and scrolled; counter remained incorrect.
Confusion matrix TP 0, FP 0, FN 1, TN 0

Developer follow-up recorded: reconcile Total Post with current Profile Posts data.

[Profile] Followers / Following

Overview

Item Details
Feature Followers / Following
Actor Signed-in user; viewer access is an alternative flow
Interface User Profile page → Connections sheet
Module Profile
QA owner @ekosy9
Project owner @lundara02
Target devices Android 13 (8 GB), Android 10 (4 GB)
Feature completion record 23 August 2021
Previous flow record Verified user opens Profile, then taps Followers or Following. Recorded 16 June 2022.

Feature intent

“Following” are users the profile owner follows. “Followers” are users who follow the profile owner. Tapping either count must show the corresponding list; a viewer may access the lists according to product permissions.

Acceptance flow

Step User action Expected result
1 Sign in, open Profile. Followers and Following counters are visible.
2 Tap Followers. Connections sheet opens on Followers with real user rows.
3 Tap Following. Tab switches and shows the corresponding real user rows.
4 Close the sheet. Profile remains usable.

Item Result

Profile counts 33 Followers; 24 Following
Runtime result Followers and Following lists loaded with real user records; sheet closed normally; no fatal or React Native JS error observed.

issue1165-pass-real.mp4
